name: xiangqi
description: Play server-validated Chinese chess with deterministic Xiangqi rules.

interface.longDescription: Start and play Chinese chess games backed by a deterministic rules engine. Xiangqi validates every move, enforces turn ownership, exposes legal moves, and reports check and game-ending states so ChatGPT and Codex do not have to guess board legality.
defaultPrompt: Start a Xiangqi game. I want to play Red.
Start a Xiangqi game. I want to play Black.
Show me all legal moves in my current Xiangqi game.
